standard_prerequisites.name: The comparison between the fppf and etale topologies
standard_prerequisites.statement: The maps a_X, epsilon_X and the identity epsilon_{X,*} o a_X^{-1} = pi_X^{-1}, plus the vanishing R^j epsilon_{X,*} = 0 for j > 0 on the relevant sheaves (the author's lemma-comparison-fppf-etale, retained as context).
standard_prerequisites.use: It rewrites a_Y^{-1} through epsilon_{Y,*} at source lines 1327-1330 and supplies the vanishing in the induction at source lines 1381-1384.

standard_prerequisites.name: Push-pull for the fppf topology
standard_prerequisites.statement: The commutative diagram relating f_{big,fppf,*} and f_{big,etale,*} (the author's lemma-push-pull-fppf-etale, retained as context).
standard_prerequisites.use: It gives the first equality in the derived chain at source lines 1360-1361.

standard_prerequisites.name: Proper comparison of higher direct images
standard_prerequisites.statement: The two parts of the proper comparison statement pi_Y^{-1} R f_{small,*} = R f_{big,etale,*} pi_X^{-1} (the author's lemma-compare-higher-direct-image-proper, retained as context).
standard_prerequisites.use: Part (1) finishes the proof of (1) at source lines 1344-1345 and part (2) gives the third equality at source lines 1365-1366.

standard_prerequisites.name: Cohomological descent for the fppf topology
standard_prerequisites.statement: The identity R f_{big,etale,*} pi_X^{-1} K = pi_Y^{-1} R f_{small,*} K for the etale and fppf topologies (the author's lemma-cohomological-descent-etale-fppf, retained as context).
standard_prerequisites.use: It gives the second and fourth equalities of the derived chain at source lines 1364 and 1367.

core_obligations: Part (1): epsilon_{Y,*} is the identity on underlying presheaves and hence reflects isomorphisms, so it suffices to identify the map after applying epsilon_{Y,*}, which the fppf comparison lemma and part (1) of the proper comparison turn into a known isomorphism (source lines 1323-1345).

Part (2), chain of equalities: the commutative diagram of the fppf push-pull lemma with composition of derived pushforwards, the fppf descent lemma, the proper comparison part (2), and the descent lemma again (source lines 1347-1367).
Reduce to the remark that a map alpha : a_Y^{-1}L -> M whose R epsilon_{Y,*}-image is an isomorphism is itself one (source lines 1368-1378).

Prove that remark by induction on i: the vanishing R^j epsilon_{Y,*} = 0 for j > 0 in the range where H^i(M) = a_Y^{-1}H^i(L), a spectral sequence argument for the next degree, and the fact that epsilon_{Y,*} reflects isomorphisms (source lines 1379-1391).

proof_roadmap.step: Part (1) by applying epsilon_{Y,*}: fppf comparison lemma plus part (1) of the proper comparison.
Part (2) by a four-term chain of equalities using the fppf push-pull diagram, the composition of derived pushforwards, the fppf descent lemma twice and the proper comparison.
Reduce to the isomorphism criterion for alpha via R epsilon_{Y,*}.
Induction on the cohomological degree using the vanishing supplied by the fppf comparison lemma and the spectral sequence argument.

difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-proper-push-pull-fppf-etale at source lines 1312-1321: for f proper it upgrades the push-pull statement of Lemma lemma-push-pull-fppf-etale to the identity a_Y^{-1} o f_{small,*} = f_{big,fppf,*} o a_X^{-1} and to its derived form a_Y^{-1}(Rf_{small,*}K) = Rf_{big,fppf,*}(a_X^{-1}K) for K in D^+(X_etale) with torsion cohomology sheaves. The author's proof at source lines 1323-1392 proves (1) by rewriting through epsilon_{Y,*}, the fppf comparison lemma and the proper comparison of higher direct images, then proves (2) by a four-term chain of equalities (commutative diagram of the fppf push-pull lemma, composition of derived pushforwards, the fppf descent lemma twice, and the proper comparison), and finishes with an induction on the cohomological degree that uses a vanishing supplied by the fppf comparison lemma plus the fact that epsilon_{Y,*} reflects isomorphisms because it is the identity on underlying presheaves. This is the fppf analogue of the ph statement and its conclusion is a different identity (the fppf pushforward rather than the ph one), so it is counted on its own interval; four results of the same chapter are retained as context and one cross-chapter result is declared as a tagged pointer.
